program_narrative: Program DB2CMT is a called DB2 commit-controller subroutine that receives LS-COMMIT-REQUEST (PROCEDURE DIVISION USING) and dispatches on its function code. 'INIT' resets the commit, rollback and savepoint counters and returns 0. 'CMIT' issues COMMIT WORK only when the caller's processed-record count has reached the commit frequency or the force flag is 'Y'; otherwise it does nothing. 'RBAK' issues ROLLBACK WORK, 'SAVE' creates a DB2 savepoint named by the caller (retaining cursors) and 'REST' rolls back to that savepoint; each successful SQL operation increments its counter (rollback-to-savepoint counts as a rollback) and returns 0. Each failed SQL operation copies the SQLCODE and a message into the caller's error area, returns 8 and calls DB2ERR with that error area (a parameter layout that does not match DB2ERR's request block; flagged for review). 'STAT' displays the three counters on the console. Any other function code returns 12 and calls the external error processor ERRPROC. It reads no files and always ends with GOBACK.

paragraphs.pseudocode_text:
-- Entry: request block LS-COMMIT-REQUEST is passed by the caller (PROCEDURE DIVISION USING, line 52)
IF request.function = 'INIT' THEN  -- FUNC-INIT (EVALUATE TRUE, first matching WHEN wins)
  CALL 1000-initialize
ELSE IF request.function = 'CMIT' THEN  -- FUNC-CMIT
  CALL 2000-commit
ELSE IF request.function = 'RBAK' THEN  -- FUNC-RBACK
  CALL 3000-rollback
ELSE IF request.function = 'SAVE' THEN  -- FUNC-SAVE
  CALL 4000-savepoint
ELSE IF request.function = 'REST' THEN  -- FUNC-REST
  CALL 5000-restore
ELSE IF request.function = 'STAT' THEN  -- FUNC-STAT
  CALL 6000-statistics
ELSE  -- WHEN OTHER: unrecognised function code
  SET err_text = 'Invalid function code'
  CALL 9000-error-routine
END IF
RETURN to caller  -- GOBACK

IF sqlcode = 0 THEN  -- CHECK SQLCODE

  SET request.return_code = 0
ELSE

  SET request.error_msg = 'Commit failed'
  SET request.return_code = 8
  CALL 9100-log-error
END IF
